🎙
Russia's President Vladimir Putin Address to the nation ahead of the 2026 State Duma elections
💬
Vladimir Putin
: Friends, citizens of Russia,
I consider it important to address you now, when our big country is going through a s
ignificant and largely definitive election campaign
.
In strict compliance with law and within the specified timeframe, we are electing members of the
State Duma, legislative assemblies, governors of several regions
, and members of
municipal bodies
.
This extensive election campaign is taking place as we continue the
special military operation
. Residents of
Donbass and Novorossiya
will be voting for State Duma deputies for the
first time since their reunification with Russia
.
I firmly believe that our soldiers and officers involved in this challenging work at the frontline will be among active voters. Their
courage and loyalty to the Fatherland are exemplary for the entire nation
.
We know what Russia is fighting for and what the duty of every citizen is
. Our heroes are forging victory on the battlefield. Everybody who is honestly working for the benefit of the country – and understand their responsibility for its future – are bringing this victory closer. Participation in the upcoming vote that is taking place during the Year of the
Unity of the Peoples of Russia
is also a responsibility and contribution to the country’s strength.
❗️
Your choice and determination will show once again that millions of people are backing our fighters and that we stand together, united by shared values, our historical memory, love for our Motherland, and that nobody can divide or intimidate us, undermine our statehood, our public and political system.
Every vote matters
. You and your personal choice will directly determine what political forces will represent people’s interests in the federal parliament, in the regions and in local governance.
I am certain that, with your support and trust,
the most deserving and competent candidates, the true patriots of Russia will come out as winners
. Those will be candidates who will not let you down and who have proved their loyalty to the Motherland and their readiness to serve our nation and protect our country from any threats.
Friends,
🗳
The voting will take place over three days, on September 18, 19 and 20.
I urge you to
exercise your constitutional right and make a thought-out and responsible decision
, so that the election results attest to the maturity and resilience of Russian society. This will be our collective response to those who seek to undermine Russia, slow down its development, or strip away our sovereignty or our right to determine our own future.
🇷🇺
Participation in the elections is our joint contribution to Russia’s victory.

🌐
Leadership in a Multipolar World: What Determines a Country’s Position in the New International Reality?
🟢
On September 15, as part of the
International Festival of Youth — 2026
, MGIMO hosted a panel discussion titled
“Leadership in a Multipolar World: What Determines a Country’s Position in the New Architecture of International Relations?”
Leading experts in international relations discussed the nature of leadership and the key factors shaping a country’s position on the global stage.
📩
The discussion was moderated by Stanislav Surovtsev
, Vice-Rector for International Cooperation, Youth and Social Policy, MGIMO University.
The panel brought together:
✅
Maria Zakharova
, Director of the Information and Press Department of the Russian MFA;
✅
Arno Gujon
, Director of the Office for Public and Cultural Diplomacy of the Government of the Republic of Serbia;
✅
Dauren Abayev
, Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the Republic of Kazakhstan to the Russian Federation.
✅
Toufik Djouama
, Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the People’s Democratic Republic of Algeria to the Russian Federation.
Here are the key takeaways from the discussion
👇
⚪
Maria Zakharova
highlighted a number of leadership qualities that challenge conventional perceptions of what it means to be a leader.
“It is commonly believed that a leader is someone who is always ahead, someone who strives to take first place. This is a misconception.
Leadership is not about competition or being formally first. Leadership is strength and confidence that become a source of support for others.
Leadership is when you are targeted by a campaign against you, yet still find the strength to keep moving forward,” Maria Zakharova emphasized.
⚪
Dauren Abayev
stressed that
domestic stability
remains the foundation of an effective foreign policy: “Without stability within a country, it is impossible to act effectively on the international stage.” Speaking about cooperation between countries and continents, he put forward the principle that
“a bridge is more important than a fortress,”
emphasizing the importance of openness, connections and communication over isolation. Dauren Askerbekovich emphasized that
Russia and Kazakhstan are key strategic partners
.
⚪
Arno Gujon
emphasized that
leadership is made possible not by words, but by actions.
“We will not pursue a policy that treats Russia immorally. This is
a principled position based on values, not political expediency.”
⚪
Toufik Djouama
outlined a fundamental principle of genuine partnership:
“It begins where people not only take, but also share.”
According to him, this principle applies equally to relations between individuals and to cooperation between states.
➡️
We thank all speakers and participants for a meaningful dialogue that brought together diverse professional and national perspectives — and for the opportunity to discuss together what defines the leadership of states today and what the world of tomorrow may look like.
🌐
MGIMO International
(ENG) /
МГИМО для иностранцев
(RUS)

🎙
Remarks and answers to questions
by Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov at the session “A New Global Architecture: An Open Dialogue with Sergey Lavrov” during the Federal Educational Marathon
“Znanie. Pervye”
(Yekaterinburg, September 16, 2026)
💬
Sergey Lavrov:
The philosophy of equality, which is becoming increasingly prevalent in today’s world,
is particularly characteristic of
#BRICS
,
the latest Summit of which has just taken place in New Delhi
.
The countries within this group represent a wide range of civilisations,
yet
demonstrate
#unity
in their pursuit of greater opportunities for shared development
– to ensure their peoples’ prosperity and security, without harming anyone else or advancing at anyone else’s expense.
☝️
Russia is fully committed to this approach
, which also characterises other groupings of a new type, including the
#SCO
,
#CIS
,
#EAEU
and
#CSTO
.
👉
Unfortunately, the objective process of strengthening multipolarity faces aggressive resistance from our Western colleagues and their elites.
They continue to view these developments as
a threat to the dominance
they enjoyed for five hundred years
–
through slavery and colonialism
. They are trying to preserve their slipping supremacy by resorting to
the most unscrupulous methods
,
including unlawful ones
: unilateral sanctions, direct pressure, interference in domestic affairs and instigation of conflicts.
***
Key points
:
•
The adaptation of international relations to multipolar realities is an objective process.
The
#GlobalMajority
wants it to succeed, although it will take time and may span an entire historical era.
• We envisage a
#MultipolarWorld
as
one in which small and medium-sized countries are free from blackmail, threats and sanctions
, where all such countries are respected and can choose their own partners.
•
For us, the Ukrainian conflict resolution requires achieving the objectives
set at the beginning of the
special military operation
,
which are aimed at eliminating the root causes of the crisis
. These include plans to bring NATO and its military infrastructure right up to Russia’s borders, as well as Ukraine's official state policy, enshrined in law, of eradicating everything Russian.
•
I would welcome nationally minded political forces coming to power in European countries.
What the Brussels bureaucracy is doing – appropriating powers and rights that essentially belong to national governments – violates, first and foremost, the EU’s own rules.
• We did not sever our relations with Europe – Europe did.
We now have all the markets and partners we need.
Despite the hybrid war against Russia, things are progressing as well as can be expected under the circumstances.
• As in previous years, we are seeing particularly pronounced
attempts by the West to interfere directly in our citizens’ exercise of their voting rights and in the election campaign.
This is especially evident abroad, but such attempts are also taking place within Russia.
• If and when European countries wish to resume a serious dialogue,
we will first listen
to what they have in mind and what they can offer,
and then decide whether it is acceptable to us.
•
If Europe
, which speaks daily about preparing for war against Russia,
attacks the Russian Federation, it will be an entirely different war.
And it will be
a very short one.
❗️
I hope this warning has been heard in European capitals and by the institutions now attempting to speak for a united Europe.

item.title: 🗓 On September 16, Russia's Deputy Foreign Minister Andrey Rudenko held a meeting with Ambassador of Japan to Russia Akira Muto.
item.description: 🗓 On September 16, Russia's Deputy Foreign Minister Andrey Rudenko held a meeting with Ambassador of Japan to Russia Akira Muto. They had a frank discussion on the most pressing bilateral issues . The Russian Side stressed that Tokyo’s continued anti-Russia policy , including the recent hysteria in Japan over President of Russia Vladimir Putin’s visit to the Southern Kuril Islands, as well as its expanding military assistance to the Kiev regime, pushes the prospect of normalising dialogue even further away , despite Japan’s publicly stated interest in doing so. The Russian Side also highlighted the dangers of Japan’s remilitarisation , Tokyo’s increased military exercises with the US and Western allies near Russia’s Far Eastern borders, the deployment of intermediate-range missile systems on Japanese territory and other such steps. ☝️ All these actions pose a direct threat to Russia’s national security and to peace and stability in Northeast Asia . Should such activities continue, Russia will take the necessary counterbalancing measures to maintain an adequate level of defence capability.

🎙
Weekly Briefing on foreign policy issues
by Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman
Maria Zakharova
(Yekaterinburg, September 15, 2026)
#UNGA81
The high-level week of
the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly
opens in New York on September 22
. As is customary, the Russian delegation will be led by Foreign Minister
Sergey Lavrov
.
The centrepiece of his programme will be
his address to the General Assembly on Saturday, September 26
.
Sergey Lavrov
will also hold a series of bilateral meetings
with representatives of friendly states taking a constructive approach.
An extensive programme of multilateral events
is also planned.
#NATO
NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte
has made yet
more belligerent anti-Russia remarks
:
“Russia wants to divide us – but we are united. Russia wants to stop us helping Ukraine – but we are going to do more for Ukraine. Russia wants to act tough – but we, we are stronger”
.
☝️
We cannot make them hate one another any more than they already do.
Mark Rutte should have told the truth
: Within their own community, they are prepared to interfere even in something as sacrosanct as elections. We have seen this
in Romania, Hungary and elsewhere
– wherever it takes to prevent the democratic expression of the people’s will and preserve a show of “solidarity”.
For that alone,
they were willing to undermine the democratic process
– and that is exactly what they did.
#Poland
On September 4, a
monument of gratitude to Red Army soldiers was demolished in Bytom by decision of the Polish authorities
. The memorial stood in a cemetery where Soviet soldiers and officers of the 21st Army of the First Ukrainian Front are buried. They fell in January 1945 during the fighting to liberate this part of Poland.
Warsaw takes “credit” for supposedly caring properly for military graves in the country and loudly proclaims its commitment to centuries-old Catholic Christian traditions.
In practice, however, its barbaric behaviour demeans itself
. In defiance of all moral standards, it continues its campaign against the memory of Poland’s liberation by the Red Army in 1944-1945.
#DialogueOnFakes
On September 22,
the Fourth International “Dialogue on Fakes” Forum
, also known as
“Dialogue on Fakes 4.0”
, will take place at
the National Centre RUSSIA
in Moscow.
🌐
The will bring together more than 2,000 participants from 80 countries.
The event has attracted considerable interest
. This reflects the high regard in which the expert community holds the forum, which, since its launch in 2023, has already become one of the leading international platforms for fact-checking.
It was at the “Dialogue on Fakes” Forum in 2024 that
the Global Fact-Checking Network
was established
. Today, it is among the leading organisations in this field, bringing together
130 experts from 55 countries
.

🎙
Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova’s
response to a media question
regarding statements by the US Secretary of the Air Force on possessing orbital weapons
(September 15, 2026)
❓
Question: US Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink
recently stated
that his country possesses “orbital weapons to control space”. How would you comment on this?
💬
Maria Zakharova:
We have taken note of
these remarks
.
❗️
For the first time, US officials have thus confirmed that their country possesses space-based weapons capabilities.
These statements provide
direct evidence
that the US is putting into practice its policy of deploying weapons in outer space and using it for combat operations to secure its own dominance and superiority.
In pursuit of its narrow, self-serving interests,
Washington is prepared to completely disregard the catastrophic consequences for humanity
that any armed conflict in orbit would entail.
The long-term sustainability of space activities is being put at risk
, as are the prospects for space exploration by all states without exception.
Enormous risks
are being created for numerous socioeconomic processes on Earth on which people’s well-being directly depends.
Troy Meink’s statements also demonstrate that US international initiatives on space security are aimed
solely at diverting the international community’s attention
from Washington’s own aggressive ambitions in outer space.
Washington’s absurd allegations that Russia supposedly intends to develop nuclear anti-satellite weapons are merely
a pretext designed to create the conditions for implementing these hegemonic plans.
The moratorium on destructive direct-ascent anti-satellite missile testing promoted by the “collective West” is steeped in hypocrisy
. In reality, it places no restrictions on the use of such weapons already in the US arsenal, nor does it cover other types of anti-satellite capabilities that Washington is interested in developing.
For many years,
Russia has consistently drawn the international community’s attention
to the grave consequences of Washington’s destructive policy for international security.
We stress the need for urgent
practical measures to prevent an arms race in outer space
(
#PAROS
).
☝️
Troy Meink’s remarks only underscore the pressing need for
Russia’s multilateral PAROS initiatives
, which seek to launch negotiations as soon as possible on
a multilateral, legally binding instrument prohibiting the placement of weapons in outer space and the threat or use of force against or by means of space objects
.
The UN General Assembly resolutions
“Further practical measures for the prevention of an arms race in outer space”
,
“No first placement of weapons in outer space”
and
“Transparency and confidence-building measures in outer space activities”
, authored by Russia,
also pursue this goal
.
